page: Microsoft Azure M128s is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8280M x86_64 processors clocked at 2.7 GHz, delivering 64 physical cores and 128 vCPUs via multithreading. It features an extensive cache hierarchy with 38 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1 data cache per core, alongside instruction set support including AVX, AVX-512, and AES-NI.

Engineered for memory-heavy configurations, the M128s provides 2048.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a 1:16 vCPU-to-memory ratio (16.0 GB per vCPU). The underlying memory subsystem delivers notable bandwidth, achieving 420.25 GB/sec in large-block read operations and 186.91 GB/sec in write operations, both measuring within the top 10% of tested instances. The instance also bundles 4398 GB of local SSD storage without dedicated GPUs.

Benchmark outcomes show an architectural divergence between single-threaded and parallel workloads. Single-core processing metrics, such as a Geekbench single-core score of 911.0 and single-threaded gzip compression at 17.3 GB/sec, fall into the lower performance tiers. Conversely, multi-core and highly parallel execution perform strongly, highlighted by a stress-ng multi-core result of 87507.83, PassMark CPU score of 53128.31, and Redis throughput reaching 80.51 million SET operations per second.

Given its massive memory capacity and substantial multi-threaded throughput, the M128s represents an efficient architecture for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, large relational database management deployments, and high-throughput memory caching grids. It is poorly suited for single-threaded processing requirements or sequential compute jobs dependent on high per-core clock frequencies.
description: Microsoft Azure M128s is a memory-optimized virtual machine equipped with 128 dedicated vCPUs (64 physical cores) based on Intel Xeon 8280M processors running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 2048.0 GB of RAM, offering a high memory density of 16.0 GB per core, paired with 4398 GB of local SSD storage and no integrated GPUs. Memory bandwidth benchmarks demonstrate strong throughput, exceeding 420 GB/sec for uncached read streams. Multi-threaded performance is robust, producing strong results in stress-ng multi-core suites and driving up to 80.51 million Redis SET operations per second. However, single-core benchmark measurements remain in lower percentiles due to modest base clock frequencies. The M128s is technically aligned with memory-intensive workloads, including large-scale in-memory enterprise databases, extensive caching layers, and high-concurrency data processing pipelines.

tagline: A high-density memory-optimized cloud server with two terabytes of RAM and massive multi-threaded capacity for large in-memory databases.
bullet_points: 128 dedicated vCPUs across 64 physical Intel Xeon 8280M cores at 2.7 GHz
2048 GB system memory with 420.25 GB/sec uncached read bandwidth
Bundled 4398 GB local SSD storage without hardware GPU acceleration
